messages:
arya: Deploy promo blocked, deploy-bot reported a checkpoint mismatch when promoting build 2026.03.21-rc3. We can't move forward until we decide rollback vs pin. Any quick thoughts?

sam.k: I'm seeing the same on the deploy bot UI. Promo stuck in step 'merge-manifest' with HTTP 409.

mike: Logs look like a race between two promo jobs. One wrote a later checkpoint, deploy-bot tried to merge an older manifest.

jen: Can you paste the exact error from the bot?

deploy-bot: ERROR promote-job-455: checkpoint_mismatch: expected_checkpoint=2026-03-21T14:02:10Z actual_checkpoint=2026-03-21T14:01:48Z, manifest_digest=a3f5...

ci-bot: Replayed CI artifacts: artifact 2026.03.21-rc3 uploaded fine. checksum verified. no content corruption on storage side.

arya: Ok so storage is ok, looks like a sequencing/lease issue. If we wait it might clear but change window closes in 25m. Ops, do we want an immediate rollback to rc2 or manual pin rc3 after forcing checkpoint?

ops-oncall: If it's a checkpoint race, forcing a new checkpoint could cause split-brain for other promos. Safer to roll back to rc2 for the release window and investigate.

sam.k: Agree. Rolling to rc2 buys the window. What's the rollback plan?

mike: Plan: (1) pin prod route to 2026.03.20-rc2 image, (2) abort current promo job, (3) reclone artifact index to a new checkpoint id, (4) schedule a controlled re-promote of rc3 after morning change window.

jen: I can run the pin and abort if someone confirms exact commands. Keep it minimal.

arya: Commands:
```
# pin route
deployctl promote --env prod --image sha256:9b8c... --force-pin
# abort job
deployctl job abort --id promote-455
```

mike: After abort, run manifest sweep to clear orphan checkpoint: `deployctl manifest sweep --checkpoint 2026-03-21T14:00:00Z`

jen: I'll do the pin now. tagging @mike to verify.

mike: watching.

jen: pin complete: prod now pinned to 2026.03.20-rc2 sha256:9b8c... :white_check_mark:

arya: Nice. Jen, please abort the job next.

jen: aborted promote-455 :ok_hand:

ci-bot: healthcheck: prod endpoints returning 200/fast. smoke tests pass (auth, search, write).

ops-oncall: Change window maintained. We'll open an incident for root cause and schedule a rollback-to-rc3 playbook after analysis.

sam.k: Quick notes for release: added a line in release-notes draft explaining we pinned to rc2 due to promotion race; rc3 will be re-promoted after checkpoint fix.

arya: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up with logs and a postmortem once we have root cause. For now release is unblocked by pin. :thumbsup:
